description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_UnitConverter, which handles conversion between different CSS length units such as px, pt, mm, cm, in, etc., including precision handling and internal calculations.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_UnitConverter
classes.description: A class for converting between different CSS length units with precision handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the converter with specified output and internal precision, and BCMath availability.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a length object from one unit to another, maintaining significant figures.

methods.name: getSigFigs
methods.description: Calculates the number of significant figures in a string number.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds two numbers with optional arbitrary precision.

methods.name: mul
methods.description: Multiplies two numbers with optional arbitrary precision.

methods.name: div
methods.description: Divides two numbers with optional arbitrary precision.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Rounds a number to a specified number of significant figures.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Scales a float to a specified number of decimal places.
